job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed el1011-wfccrp-bb847e831-tc-hm25-pr (dsfd_wfc_crp, RTL bb847e831, snapshot of 2 drifted files): same RTL, outline 302.4x237.6, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:el1011-ds-wfc

benches.name: crp_stg_r1
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_crp_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_crp_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 tools/dsrom_wfc_kit_cr_bench.py --oskid --out {RUN}/bench --case crp_stg_r1
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the bb847e831 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_crp_m5/src]
